title: Mark a version authoritative
description: Makes a DOCX version the authoritative one (the previous authoritative version becomes superseded). Requires a manual confirmation. No version is modified or deleted; only the status in the manifest changes.

doc_id.description: Document identifier: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens

confirmation_manuelle.description: Manual confirmation: oui (or true) to proceed

approved_by.description: Person who gave the confirmation, recorded as stated (not attested)

base_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the manifest as read by the caller; refused when the manifest changed since
